invite.invalidOrExpired: This invitation link is invalid, expired, or has been replaced.

welcome.title: What is your name?
welcome.body: This invitation is yours. Add your name once, then use the same QR code whenever you come back.

login.title: Admin
login.body: Sign in to create and manage weddings.

home.sharedInvite: This invitation is shared. Uploads and votes belong to both of you.
home.concluded: This wedding has concluded. You can still browse photos.

upload.title: Upload
upload.closedBody: This wedding has already concluded. Uploads are no longer available.
upload.alreadyInCategory: You have already uploaded a photo to this category.
upload.replaceBody: If you delete this photo and upload a new one, you will lose every point this photo has gathered so far. You can only do this until the wedding is concluded.

voteHelp.title: Photos & voting
voteHelp.intro: You can share the evening in two ways: upload to the shared Gallery, or enter your favourites in the photo contest.
voteHelp.galleryBody1: The Gallery is the shared album of the evening, where we collect the best moments of the wedding together.
voteHelp.galleryBody2: You can upload up to {{max}} photos here during the evening.
voteHelp.galleryBody3: Photos in the Gallery do not automatically enter the contest. Use it for anything you would like to share with the couple and the other guests.
voteHelp.contestBody: The contest has several categories, and you can enter 1 photo of your own in each category.
voteHelp.voteBody: In the Vote menu, you can vote by selecting a category.
voteHelp.noSelfVote: You cannot vote on your own photo.
voteHelp.separateWinners: Each category has its own contest and its own winner.

categories.title: Vote
categories.caughtUpBody: No more photos to vote on here.

quickVote.title: A short mix
quickVote.fewerReady: {{ready}} photos are ready — fewer than the usual {{requested}}.
quickVote.caughtUpBody: There are no more photos for you to vote on right now.
quickVote.doneBody: You voted on {{count}} photos. Thank you.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.emptyBody: Be the first to upload a moment from the evening.

vote.cardLabel: Photo to vote on. Drag right for a point, left to pass.

home.timelineBody: Photos around dinner, the first dance, and other moments
home.topPhotosBody: Top 5 overall, then top 5 and top 10 in each category
home.concludeBody: After concluding, guests will no longer be able to upload or vote on photos.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.empty: Photos and wedding moments will appear here in order.

admin.title: Admin
admin.quickVoteHelp: Guests swipe through a short mix of photos.
admin.coverBody: Shown on the guest home screen. JPEG, PNG, WebP, or iPhone HEIC.
admin.quickVoteBody: Optional. When this is off, guests will not see Quick Vote on this wedding.
admin.categoriesBody: Guests only see enabled categories. You can delete a category even if it already has contest photos.
admin.deleteCategoryBody: Delete “{{name}}”? This permanently removes the category and every contest photo in it, including all points those photos have received.
admin.timelineBody: Highlight dinner, the first dance, midnight cake, and other moments on the reviewer timeline. Photos appear around these times.
admin.guestsBody: Add blank invitations. Each QR is personal: the guest writes their name the first time they open it, then uses that same code as their account.
admin.reviewersBody: Only couple accounts can conclude the wedding and see final rankings.

errors.galleryLimit: You can upload up to {{count}} general gallery photos.
errors.guestBatchLimit: You can add at most {{count}} guests at once.
